sections.text: YAP1::TFE3 is associated with a distinctive epithelioid vascular tumor group with nuclear TFE3 expression. Functional models demonstrate fusion-dependent transcriptional activity and transforming properties.

audit_evidence.scope: Fusion domain architecture and oncogenic transcription/transformation assays.

report_comment.text: YAP1 encodes a transcriptional coactivator regulated by Hippo signaling. TFE3 encodes an E-box-binding transcription factor. Functional models demonstrate fusion-dependent transcriptional activity and transforming properties.
